text:
maria: Quick sync: VerdantHeat dedicated bring-up this week. Need checklist for quota allocation, autoscale taper, and rollback triggers.

ashley: Sales says baseline ~22k tokens/min, promo spikes could reach 110k tokens/min for 10-20m windows. We'll need clear billing treatment.

tony: Ops suggestion: reserve baseline+30% (~29k) and autoscale to 130k with conservative scale-down (prevent thrash). smoothing 90s, cooldown 300s.

sam_engineer: I'll run a staging replay: 15m baseline soak, then 3 bursts: 60kx5m, 100kx5m, 130kx10m. Tag runs verdant-stg-<TS>. Vegeta + traffic-replay.

kevin: Customer approved shadowing for 1h. Hard-stop: p95 > 500ms OR 5xx rate > 1% -> immediate rollback. I'll own comms.

ashley: Rollback steps: 1) flip router to shared pool, 2) pause burst tokens, 3) notify customer + open incident. I'll add cost mapping to runbook.

maria: Add quality gate: run 100 evals pre/post each burst stage. Fail if regression > 2%. Post results to run log.

sam_engineer: Staging run scheduled 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. Will post run id and logs after completion.

tony: I'll add automated fallback script and an emergency kill if latency breach persists > 3 mins.

maria: Reconvene 08:00 PT for go/no-go. Thanks.
